description:
Half 1 of ISS-022: warn (once) when the on-disk config changed after the MCP server spawned. No reload, no behavior change — just kill the silent-staleness trap.

## Why
`createServer()` in `src/server.ts` calls `loadConfig()` exactly once (~line 67) and never looks at the file again. Users are told to edit `.reviewbridge.json` to tune the bridge, but a running MCP server silently ignores edits until the client restarts — this burned two real sessions (config fixes appeared to do nothing).

## What to build
1. `loadConfig()` in `src/config/loader.ts` (~line 118) already returns `LoadedConfig = { config, source }` where `source` is `{ kind: 'default' } | { kind: 'env' | 'project' | 'user', path }`. At server startup, capture: the source path (if any) and its `fs.statSync(path).mtimeMs` at spawn time.
2. Add a small module in `src/config/` (e.g. `staleness.ts`): `makeConfigStalenessCheck(source: ConfigSource): () => string | null`. Each call stats the path and returns a warning message the FIRST time it detects divergence, null otherwise (and null forever after the first warning — one-time only).
   - `kind: 'default'` (no file at spawn): also handle the file APPEARING later — stat the two paths the cascade would find first (`join(process.cwd(), '.reviewbridge.json')` walk-up is overkill; checking cwd + `join(homedir(), '.reviewbridge.json')` covers the realistic cases; document that limitation in a comment).
   - stat errors (ENOENT after spawn, permissions): return null — never warn on noise, never throw.
3. Wire it in `src/server.ts`: create the checker right after line ~75 (where `config source:` is logged) and invoke it at the top of each tool handler registration's execute path — simplest seam: pass the checker into `registerReviewPlanTool` / `registerReviewCodeTool` / `registerReviewPrecommitTool` (lines ~100-102) or wrap the backend once. Emit via `console.error('[codex-bridge] <msg>')` matching existing narration style, e.g.: `.reviewbridge.json changed on disk after this server started; the running config is stale. Restart or reconnect the MCP server (/mcp in Claude Code) to apply it.`
4. CLI is untouched (fresh process per invocation already reloads).

## Tests (write first — TDD)
Colocate `src/config/staleness.test.ts`. Use `vi.spyOn` on fs or inject a stat function (prefer injection — the codebase favors dependency seams over module mocks). Cases: unchanged mtime → null; newer mtime → message once then null; file appears when spawn had defaults → message; stat throws → null; env-sourced path honored. Also one server-level test in `server.test.ts` asserting a stale config triggers exactly one stderr warning across two tool calls (mock the backend as existing server tests do — do NOT mock chunking/config internals, per the prod-realistic-tests rule).

## Acceptance
- `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npx vitest run` green.
- Manual: start `node dist/index.js` as MCP (or use server tests), touch `.reviewbridge.json`, invoke two tools → exactly one warning on stderr.
- Does NOT resolve ISS-022 by itself — T-035 (reload) completes it; leave the issue open, reference this ticket in a progress note on it.

## Conventions
TypeScript strict, no `any`; Result<T> (no throws); ESM `.js` import suffixes; config layer must NOT import from review/backends layers; stderr only (stdout belongs to MCP transport); no AI names in commits.
title: Warn when .reviewbridge.json changed on disk after MCP server spawn (ISS-022a)
